title: Probation of Offenders Ordinance Application to Tribal Areas of Baluchistan Regulation 1972

sections.shortTitle: Probation of Offenders Ordinance Application to Tribal Areas of Baluchistan Regulation 1972
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

PROBATION OF OFFENDERS ORDINANCE (APPLICATION TO TRIBAL AREAS OF
BALUCHISTAN) REGULATION, 1972
PROBATION OF OFFENDERS
ORDINANCE (APPLICATION TO TRIBAL AREAS
OF BALUCHISTAN) REGULATION, 1972
1. Short title,
extent and commencement.‑(1) This Regulation may be called the
Probation of Offenders Ordinance (Application to Tribal Areas of Baluchistan) Regulation,
1972.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Tribal Areas of the Province of Baluchistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Application of Probation of Offenders Ordinance 1960, to the tribal areas of Baluchistan

PROBATION OF OFFENDERS ORDINANCE (APPLICATION TO TRIBAL AREAS OF
BALUCHISTAN) REGULATION, 1972
PROBATION OF OFFENDERS
ORDINANCE (APPLICATION TO TRIBAL AREAS
OF BALUCHISTAN) REGULATION, 1972
2. Application of Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960, to the Tribal
Areas of Baluchistam‑The provisions of the Probation of Offenders
;Ordinance, 1960 (XLV of 1960), and the rules made thereunder shall apply to
the whole of the Tribal Areas of the Province of Baluchistan as they apply to
the other areas of the Province.
